recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly angled portrait of a woman with dark hair against a warm, textured yellow-orange background, featuring stylized decorative typography in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame
Warm background color harmonizes with skin tones and hair highlights
Typography is nested in the negative space created by the subject's head and shoulder
Soft, diffused lighting creates a gentle transition between subject and background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale head and shoulders portrait, positioned on the right, looking toward the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bold, decorative title in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's gaze on the right, across to the text on the left, then down the flowing hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid but textured warm field in the upper left provides a canvas for the primary text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with low-to-medium value contrast for a soft, vintage feel.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues except as small typographic accents
No harsh whites or neon colors

letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with thin horizontal connectors
Exaggerated, curling swashes on ascenders and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature ornate, whip-like tails
Lowercase letters are tightly kerned and nested
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, heavy decorative display paired with a delicate, flowing cursive script.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, ornate western aesthetic
Matches the organic, flowing curves of the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s style portrait of a woman with long dark hair, looking slightly off-camera. Use a warm amber-yellow textured background. Lighting should be soft and warm, reminiscent of 35mm film.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large decorative western-style title in the upper left using teal with a white outline. Below it, add a smaller line of text in a delicate black script.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm, textured yellow?
Does the primary text have ornate swashes?
Is the subject positioned on the right side of the frame?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible but highly decorative
Verify the balance between subject and negative space
Confirm the teal/amber color contrast works effectively
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on right + Warm textured field on left + Ornate Western display text + Script subtitle = Vintage Country Aesthetic
